current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly clear, with a low around 82. North wind around 15 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms after 11am. Partly sunny. High near 92, with temperatures falling to around 90 in the afternoon. Heat index values as high as 108. North wind 15 to 25 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 7am, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly sunny, with a high near 90. Heat index values as high as 105. South wind around 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%.
